verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own locations page lists offices across many countries: Germany (5 offices), UK (3), Italy (3), Spain (3), US (2 – New York, San Francisco), plus Singapore and China. Its EC&VC team also describes 'multi-jurisdictional support' to help clients scale, so a founder expanding into these markets would not immediately need a second firm. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the office footprint, and explicit evidence of locally qualified lawyers in each office (India, for example, is served through trips rather than an office).

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
